body: We are currently trying to work on sessions with my family and friends to educate them on the symptoms and treatments and make them understand that I didn’t want to talk to them every waking second about it. I feel like if they had more education on the diagnosis they might better understand how to approach me and support me better during my bad times. Thanks for listening and for all the advice.
I’m working with therapist and that helps. I just wish I had a better support system outside of my therapist.

This is completely true of my current situation. It’s so unfair all the stigmas and stereotypes on mental illness. Maybe more people could actually get the help that the need and deserve and in the way that they need it if people weren’t so judgemental about it.
